recipe_version.title: Bangers and Mash with Onion Gravy
recipe_version.description: The British pub classic: plump pork sausages browned slowly in a skillet, served on fluffy buttery mashed potatoes and smothered in a rich, glossy onion gravy made in the same pan, finished with chives.

ingredients.name: pork sausages
ingredients.display_name: fresh pork sausages (British bangers or mild Italian) whose label lists no egg, soy, milk, or sesame
ingredients.note: about 2 lb; store-bought; required: the ingredient list shows no egg, soy, milk, or sesame

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 2 tsp potato water, 3/4 tsp mash, 1/4 tsp onions

steps.title: Prep and start the potatoes
steps.body: Peel and chunk the potatoes and put them in a 5-quart pot with 12 cups (3 quarts) cold water and 2 tsp salt over high heat. Slice the onions and snip the chives.

steps.title: Brown the sausages
steps.body: Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-low. Cook the sausages, turning every few minutes, until browned all over and 160 F inside, about 14 minutes. Move to a plate.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Meanwhile, once the 3 quarts of water boil, cook the potatoes until they fall apart when pierced, about 20 minutes. Runs inside steps 2 and 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the onion gravy
steps.body: In the sausage fat over medium, cook the onions with 1/4 tsp salt, stirring, until soft and deep golden, 10 minutes. Sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute, then whisk in the stock, thyme, and Dijon and simmer until it coats a spoon, 3 minutes. Return the sausages to warm through.

steps.title: Mash
steps.body: Drain the potatoes, return them to the warm pot, and mash with the butter, warm milk, 3/4 tsp salt, and the pepper until fluffy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon mash onto plates, lay two sausages on each, smother with onion gravy, and scatter chives.

components.name: browned pork sausages with onion gravy
